D/ CONSTANTINVS[---] ; R/ GLOR IA EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 332-333, Reece period 17, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS[---]. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXERC ITVS. In exergue: TR.S. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 1.74gms,…
